privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Which data we collect and how we use it.

sections.heading: 1. Data Collection
sections.body: Flow Digital Lab collects the following personal data when you use our website:
list: **Contact data:** Name, email and message when you fill in the contact form.
**Browsing data:** IP address, browser, device and pages visited via technical cookies.
**Voluntary data:** Any additional information you choose to share with us.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Data
sections.body: Your data is used exclusively to:
list: Respond to your contact and quote requests.
Improve the browsing experience on our website.
Send you communications about our services (only with your consent).
Comply with legal and tax obligations.
sections.footer: **We do not sell or share your data with third parties** for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Data Security
sections.body: We adopt technical and organisational security measures to protect your personal data:
list: Secure HTTPS connection for all communications.
Access to data restricted to authorised personnel only.
Regular backups and up-to-date protection systems.

sections.heading: 4. Your Rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679), you have the right to:
list: **Access:** Request a copy of your personal data.
**Rectification:** Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
**Erasure:** Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten").
**Portability:** Receive your data in a structured format.
**Objection:** Object to the processing of your data for specific purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
sections.body: For any question about our Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, contact us:

terms.title: Terms &
terms.subtitle: The rules that apply to our services.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By using the Flow Digital Lab website and our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use our services.
sections.footer: We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. Changes take effect from the date they are published on the site.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Services
sections.body: Flow Digital Lab offers the following services:
list: **Web Design & Development:** Design and development of custom websites.
**Branding:** Creation of visual identities, logos and brand guidelines.
**Digital Strategy:** Strategic consulting, SEO and digital marketing.
sections.footer: The specific details of each project are defined in a separate quote, which forms an integral part of the contract.

sections.heading: 3. Payments and Billing
list: **Deposit:** 50% of the total amount is due at the start of the project.
**Balance:** The remaining 50% is due on delivery of the project.
**Methods:** Bank transfer, PayPal or credit card.
**Invoicing:** An electronic invoice is issued for each payment.
sections.footer: Prices are to be understood as excluding VAT, unless otherwise stated.

sections.heading: 4. Revisions and Changes
sections.body: The quote includes a specific number of revision rounds (usually 2-3). Additional revisions beyond those included will be quoted separately.
sections.footer: Substantial changes to the project scope after initial approval may result in additional costs and changes to delivery times.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.body: **Before final payment:** All materials produced remain the property of Flow Digital Lab.
sections.footer: **After final payment:** The client acquires full ownership of all agreed deliverables, including source files, graphics and code. Flow Digital Lab reserves the right to showcase completed work in its own portfolio, unless specific non-disclosure agreements (NDA) apply.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Flow Digital Lab is not liable for:
list: Indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.
Issues caused by third-party services (hosting, domain, etc.).
Delays due to lack of collaboration or late feedback from the client.
sections.footer: Our maximum liability is limited to the total amount paid for the project.

sections.heading: 7. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by Italian law. Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the court where Flow Digital Lab is domiciled.

audit.heading: Free website audit
audit.text: In 30 minutes we tell you what slows your site down, what Google is missing and what we'd fix first.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: It depends on pages, features and content. After a first call we send a free quote with costs and timing. You pay 50% at the start and 50% on delivery.
It depends on the project. After the call, the delivery date is written in the quote.
We measure results and fix what needs fixing. The support included is listed in the quote.

items.q: Can I update the content myself?
items.a: Yes. At delivery we show you how to edit text and images, and the quote states how you will manage content.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside my city?
items.a: Yes, we work remotely across Italy.
